note: Reference outputs of the clean originals built by the real clang/wasm32 toolchain in build.sh. The live grader is tests/recover_differential.rs, which assembles the real-toolchain wat under real/ and executes clean vs recover_module(obf) under wasmtime over an input battery; these are a static cross-check of representative cases.

opaque_select.note: real clang -O0; the collatz(9)==1 / collatz(27)==1 guards are true so the obf computes the true arm, equal to the clean. recover_module walls the -O0 opaque predicate (it needs an interprocedural interpreter) but leaves behavior intact; values below are the clean originals.

mba_checksum.formula: mix(a,b) = ((a + b) * 5 ^ a) * 1103515245 + 12345 (i32 wrapping); blend chains two MBA adds; checksum folds a windowed accumulator
mba_checksum.note: exact values are large i32-wrapping products; graded behaviorally by the differential over the battery rather than tabulated here. mix and blend each fold one real -O2 shl-form MBA add; checksum is behaviorally verified but not folded (its add is shared through a local.tee).

decrypt_stub.note: static-extraction case: recover_module decrypts the constant-key data section in place; the recovered data segment equals the plaintext bytes "helloworld". Not execution-graded (the static decrypt intentionally diverges from the live double-decrypt).
